evidence.quote: Inflation is now much closer to the Federal Open Market Committee's (FOMC) 2 percent objective. I expect that we will continue to make progress toward that goal.
Even so, the cooling in the labor market is noticeable.
as risks to inflation have diminished and risks to employment have risen, these risks have been brought roughly into balance.
I will carefully watch incoming data, the evolving outlook, and the balance of risks when considering additional adjustments to the federal funds target range
To maintain the strength of the labor market, my FOMC colleagues and I recalibrated our policy stance last month, lowering our policy interest rate by 1/2 percentage point
